title: Quiet ridge over NW Europe — negative case (no deep low)
notes: Mid-June 2023 sat under a persistent ridge over the UK/Channel (the record-warm settled June). Negative expectation is 'no low below 1005 hPa' rather than 'no systems' — highs count as systems and the detector SHOULD find the ridge. Bounds narrowed to the Channel/Biscay approaches (43-58N, 15W-5E) so a legitimately-detected distant Icelandic low cannot fail a case that is about quiet target waters. Confidence: high on the settled spell; the exact absence of any sub-1005 low in the box is what the case tests.
